common.reference_usage: the character's identity and colours: dark auburn hair in a bun with a pencil, brass loupe on a green band, cream blouse, sage green apron. Draw this person as a tiny full-body walking sprite, not a portrait

walk_leah.style_usage: exact Stardew Valley NPC sprite sheet: 16x32 frames in a 4x4 grid, row order down/right/up/left, character about 28 px tall, big head, few colours, dark coloured outlines
walk_leah.description: Stardew Valley NPC walking sprite sheet of Margot Pell, a small woman in her early thirties, a museum painting conservator: 4 rows by 4 columns of 16x32 pixel frames. Row 1: walking toward the viewer (facing down). Row 2: walking right (side view). Row 3: walking away (back view). Row 4: walking left (side view). Each row is a 4-frame walk cycle. Full body: light skin, dark auburn hair in a messy pinned-up bun with a yellow pencil through it, a brass loupe on a green band on her forehead, cream blouse with rolled sleeves, a sage green work apron down to the knees, brown corduroy trousers, brown shoes. Exactly the same sheet layout, character size, proportions and pixel style as the reference sheet
